newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $626 mln for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $626 mln for Thursday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Thursday, June 12 are expected to total $626 million in 28 deals according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $408 million in 13 sales, with a $188 million Tyler Health Facilities, Texas, deal through Lehman Brothers topping the list.
On the competitive side, 15 sales totaling $218 million are scheduled. A $76 million Rhode Island deal at 1100 EDT is the largest.
An additional three sales totaling $21 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Thursday depending on market conditions.
